decision: Do not add PD as a default initial-guess stage. All iteration counts gave worse poses than the velocity predictor in 6 of 7 samples; even one iteration had substantial overhead.
limitations: Single-pass screening timings include JIT and are not a speedup benchmark.
PD penalty contacts and chordal material forces are used only to propose a pose, never to certify a physical step.
Raw force residual is measured with zero reactions; it is not an equilibrium certificate.
This screen does not run Newton from the guess and cannot establish final trajectory accuracy.
nextRequirement: Any alternative reduced predictor must demonstrate lower total time including the full original force/contact/friction certificate, on the unchanged dt and inertia/friction reference.
